name: Asagiri Mai
source:
Mai is [url=/c1355]Tatsuya's[/url] younger sister who attends the same school as him. She is the part leader for the flutes in the concert band in her school. [spoiler]A secret between her and Tatsuya is that she is actually adopted.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yoake_Mae_yori_Ruriiro_na]Wikipedia[/url].]
